title: 4 days ago I shared my destructible browser FPS built with Claude Code. Since then I've added heists, smarter bots, co-op and a ton of improvements.
author: Affectionate_Tie6915
selftext:
I posted East Bank here a couple days ago and got some pretty useful feedback, so I've been working on a bunch of updates since then.

For anyone who missed it, it's a browser FPS with a destructible city, weapons, vehicles, and bots.

The biggest addition is probably heists. You can now rob different locations around the city, play with a friend, or challenge someone to beat your completion time.

I also added a nighttime stealth mission where you're dropped onto a rooftop by helicopter. You can use night vision, turn your flashlight on and off, and sneak around guards who react to light, noise and movement.

There's also different enemy types now, including tougher elite guards. I've improved the bots quite a bit too, especially their navigation, cover and combat behavior.

Besides that, a bunch of smaller stuff like sliding, climbing, automatic pickups, better HUD indicators, faster healing, and general bug fixes.

Still building everything with Claude Code. It's pretty interesting how quickly you can add features, although getting them to actually work well together still takes a lot of iteration.

Btw, the game is completely free to play now without any time limits or required sign-in. 

[https://eastbank.fly.dev/](https://eastbank.fly.dev/)

It's pretty late here so I didn't attach any screenshots or videos this time. Might post some actual gameplay tomorrow.

Still working on improving it, so any feedback would be useful, especially on the new heists and stealth mechanics.
